text.tspan: The 7 OSI layers: what each one adds, and what works there
port to port, reliable or not
next hop on the same network
bits on a wire or radio
Sending: each layer wraps the data from the layer above
(adds its header) and passes it DOWN: encapsulation.
Receiving: each layer reads its header and passes it UP.
Remember 7 → 1: All People Seem To Need Data Processing
TCP/IP folds 7 + 6 + 5 into one Application layer,
